errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are ordered clockwise by size from largest to smallest. The actual clockwise order starting from the top is Industry (28.0%), Transport (34.6%), Services (12.6%), Households (22.9%), and Agriculture (1.9%), which is not a descending order of value.
